diagnosis: The analytics heatmap endpoint queries an internal ClickHouse aggregation service via a shared client package with service-level credentials. It fails to check whether the requesting user owns or has access to the specified projectId. Any user can view page click coordinates, button engagement rates, and aggregate UI interaction data of any project on the platform.
exploit_request:
GET /api/analytics/heatmaps?projectId=proj_rival_checkout_flow&pagePath=/checkout/step2 HTTP/1.1
Host: dashboard.saasmetrics.io:8085
Cookie: session_token=standard_user_cookie
